name: Documented employment / lawful current-account income
eligibility: Foreign individual with lawful mainland current-account RMB income and matching tax/source evidence.
steps: Ask the holding bank for its current salary/current-income checklist and classification decision.
Collect identity, employment/service contract or certificate, employer income statement, tax payment evidence and account records.
Reconcile the requested amount to documented lawful income; do not reuse or fabricate documents.
Have the bank perform authenticity review, purchase USD and remit to the approved destination.
Retain the bank advice, exchange rate, fee invoice and tax evidence for U.S. reporting.
pros: Directly addresses the likely salary case.
SAFE guidance does not state a universal USD50,000 salary ceiling.
cons: Legacy savings without income/tax trail may not qualify.
Bank acceptance and local checklist remain unconfirmed.
known_cost_note: Permission route has no standalone published price. Add the actual chosen bank/channel quote; blanks are not zero.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Pension, severance, retirement or compensation income
eligibility: Non-mainland individual with lawful payment from the disbursing organization.
steps: Obtain the disbursing organization’s payment statement and supporting tax/source documents.
Ask the bank to classify the payment under current-account income.
Submit identity and transaction-value evidence; complete bank review.
Purchase USD and remit through an approved channel; retain all advices.
pros: Recognized documentary category in HSBC guidance.
cons: Not a route for undocumented principal.
Provider fees and taxes depend on facts.
known_cost_note: No standalone published price; underlying payment tax and channel quote remain blank.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Domestic-individual annual facilitation purchase
eligibility: Only if the bank classifies the holder as a domestic individual under applicable rules; not assumed from U.S. citizenship alone.
steps: Obtain the bank’s written classification and available facilitation amount.
Use only the holder’s own lawful funds and truthful purpose; never borrow another person’s quota.
Purchase within the applicable annual facilitation amount or obtain documentary approval for a genuine excess current-account purpose.
Remit through the bank and retain the purpose/fee records.
pros: Simple when the holder actually qualifies.
cons: U.S. passport holder is not automatically domestic.
State Council definition can include foreigners resident at least one year; classification is fact-specific.
Multi-year staging is not a universal answer for a foreign individual.
known_cost_note: USD50,000 is a facilitation amount, not a fee or tax. No cost is inferred from the quota.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Foreign permanent-residence ID facilitation
eligibility: Holder of a PRC Foreigner’s Permanent Residence ID Card, subject to bank verification.
steps: Present the permanent-residence ID and ask the bank to confirm purchase-facilitation treatment.
Confirm remaining annual amount and truthful purpose.
Execute only within the bank’s approved procedure and retain records.
pros: SAFE expressly extends purchase facilitation to this ID category.
cons: A passport alone is not this ID.
Does not prove eligibility for this user.
known_cost_note: No standalone price; quota is not a tax.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Genuine current-account purpose above facilitation
eligibility: Domestic individual or other eligible holder with a genuine current-account transaction exceeding facilitation.
steps: Identify the actual current-account purpose (for example education or medical payment).
Collect the contract/invoice/payment notice and identity documents required for that purpose.
Submit to the bank; accept direct-to-counterparty payment where required.
Do not disguise capital transfer or savings repatriation as a current-account expense.
pros: Lawful excess can be documented rather than split.
cons: Not a generic savings loophole.
Documents must match the transaction and cannot be reused falsely.
known_cost_note: No universal fee; outbound tax filing may apply depending on payment type and exceptions.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Unused-RMB reconversion
eligibility: RMB left from a prior foreign-currency/card/traveler-cheque conversion, with original evidence.
steps: Locate the original physical exchange slip and confirm it is within 24 months.
Reconcile the remaining RMB to the original converted amount.
For larger amounts present the slip; ID-only handling is limited to USD500 daily or USD1,000 at specified pre-departure locations.
Have the bank reconvert and remit/carry only as permitted.
pros: Useful for genuine leftover travel money.
cons: Not a solution for old RMB savings with no original conversion.
Small daily thresholds do not scale to USD400,000.
known_cost_note: No standalone price; original exchange rate and current bank quote remain unknown.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Property-sale net proceeds
eligibility: Lawful owner selling mainland property and meeting current bank/SAFE/tax requirements.
steps: Confirm ownership, sale registration and the applicable local checklist.
Complete required PRC tax filings and obtain tax evidence.
Reconcile sale price, taxes, fees and net proceeds; request bank authenticity review.
Remit only the approved lawful net amount through the bank.
pros: Recognized route for actual property proceeds.
cons: Gross sale price is not automatically remittable.
Older Q&A and local practice require current confirmation.
known_cost_note: Property-transfer tax categories may apply; no flat conversion tax or personalized amount is assumed.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Emigration personal-asset transfer
eligibility: Person who acquired qualifying assets before immigration and meets the personal-asset-transfer rules.
steps: Confirm eligibility and the competent SAFE office with the bank/SAFE.
Prepare identity, immigration/status evidence, lawful-source and ownership documents.
Apply for the required approval/registration for the whole amount.
After approval, transfer in a lump sum or batches as permitted by the current circular; retain approval and bank records.
pros: Current circular removes the old mandatory installment schedule.
cons: Not available merely because the holder is a U.S. citizen.
Approval, source proof and timing are unconfirmed.
known_cost_note: No published approval fee or personalized tax amount; historical staged-remittance rules are not used.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Inherited personal-asset transfer
eligibility: Eligible foreign inheritor of lawful mainland assets.
steps: Establish inheritance rights and the deceased’s former domicile jurisdiction.
Collect ownership, inheritance and tax/source documents.
Apply to the competent SAFE office; current rules permit combined applications as specified.
After approval, remit through the bank and retain the approval trail.
pros: Recognized capital-account route.
Current circular permits combined inheritance applications as specified.
cons: Not a shortcut for the holder’s own undocumented savings.
known_cost_note: Inheritance itself is generally not U.S. income, but later income and Form3520 reporting may apply; see tax page.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Bank of China cross-border wire
eligibility: Customer whose underlying purchase/remittance is approved by BOC.
steps: Obtain BOC’s current tariff and the bank’s documentary approval for the underlying funds.
Request a firm FX quote and identify fee option (OUR/BEN/full-arrival if available).
Confirm receiving/intermediary charges and whether USD full-arrival uses the BOC New York route.
Execute and retain the advice showing rate, CNY fee, cable fee and any surcharge.
pros: Transparent published issuance/cable formula.
Conditional USD15/25 full-arrival surcharge is separately published.
cons: FX spread and ordinary receiving/intermediary deductions are not fixed by the tariff.
Full-arrival is not universal.
known_cost_note: Known component: 0.1% of benchmark CNY amount, clamped CNY50–260, plus CNY150 international cable. Conditional full-arrival USD15/25 shown separately; all-in remains blank.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: HSBC China Premier/Advance telegraphic transfer
eligibility: Eligible HSBC China Premier/Advance individual with approved underlying funds.
steps: Confirm individual customer tier and current tariff edition.
Obtain documentary approval and a firm FX quote.
Confirm Pay Exact need: CNY200 base plus any overseas-charge shortfall; Elite/Passport exemptions may apply.
Execute TT and retain issuance, cable, FX and third-party charge records.
pros: Published 0.1% min CNY100/max CNY500 plus CNY120 cable.
cons: Tier eligibility and monthly-fee conditions are not established.
Other institutions’ charges are excluded.
known_cost_note: Known component is Premier/Advance individual issuance plus cable only. Private Banking entity prices are not applied to individuals.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: HSBC Global Transfer to own overseas account
eligibility: Eligible customer with own eligible overseas HSBC account and approved funds/currency.
steps: Confirm home-country eligibility, destination country and account ownership.
Confirm transfer limits and whether the service is available for the currency.
Obtain the FX quote separately; complete the transfer and retain records.
pros: Published service can be free for eligible tiers.
cons: Free service does not establish zero FX spread or third-party charges.
Not a separate legal permission to move capital.
known_cost_note: Published HSBC service charge may be free for eligible tiers; FX spread, eligibility and receiving charges remain blank.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Wise sending from CNY
eligibility: Non-mainland individual with China work/tax history meeting Wise’s current eligibility.
steps: Check Wise’s current sending-from-CNY eligibility and own-account destination rule.
Prepare identity, work and tax records requested by Wise.
Enter the actual amount and obtain an executable quote showing fee, rate and recipient amount.
Respect CNY300,000 bank-funded / CNY50,000 Alipay per-transfer limits and remaining lawful-income limit.
Execute only after the quote and compliance checks; retain records.
pros: Provider publishes eligibility and per-transfer limits.
cons: No live fee/rate quote obtained.
Not available to every passport holder or every source of funds.
known_cost_note: Fee, spread and recipient amount are blank until a real quote exists.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Remit existing foreign currency already in the account
eligibility: Holder already has lawful USD/foreign currency in a mainland account; no CNY conversion needed.
steps: Ask the bank to distinguish account FX from cash and confirm outward-remittance documents.
Confirm source/purpose and any capital-account restrictions.
Obtain the bank’s outward-remittance quote and execute to the approved account.
pros: Avoids a new CNY→USD conversion spread.
cons: Does not solve a CNY-only balance.
Outward transfer still requires compliance and may incur fees.
known_cost_note: No CNY conversion component; actual outward-remittance fees remain blank unless the chosen tariff applies.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Overseas ATM cash withdrawal
eligibility: Eligible cardholder within SAFE per-person annual and per-card daily limits.
steps: Confirm card network, issuer fee and ATM surcharge before withdrawal.
Track RMB100,000/person/year and RMB10,000/card/day across cards.
Withdraw only within limits; do not use multiple cards/people to evade them.
Report currency/monetary instruments over USD10,000 on U.S. entry and comply with PRC export rules.
pros: Can cover small living-expense cash needs.
cons: Not scalable for USD400,000.
Excess can suspend current and next year withdrawals.
BOC fees change by card network from 2026-11-11.
known_cost_note: BOC issuer fee is published by network; ATM surcharge and FX rate remain blank. Annual limit makes large-tier execution infeasible.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Genuine overseas card consumption
eligibility: Cardholder making genuine personal consumption payments.
steps: Use the card only for actual goods/services.
Keep merchant receipts and issuer statements.
Do not fabricate purchases, refund to another person, or use merchants to cash out.
pros: SAFE distinguishes genuine consumption from ATM cash limits.
cons: Does not move savings into a U.S. bank account.
Issuer FX rate/fees are unquoted.
known_cost_note: No repatriation cost is calculated because this is not a lawful cash-out method.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Carry foreign-currency cash across borders
eligibility: Person able to obtain required PRC bank/SAFE carry permission and meet U.S. reporting.
steps: Confirm lawful source and obtain the required bank carry permit for above USD5,000 through USD10,000 equivalent.
Do not carry above USD10,000 without the special SAFE approval required by the rule.
Declare/report more than USD10,000 to U.S. CBP on FinCEN105; family/group threshold is collective.
Retain permits, declaration and deposit evidence.
pros: Transparent reporting can make small lawful carriage possible.
cons: Not a USD400,000 solution.
Security, deposit, FX cash-rate and permit costs are unquoted.
known_cost_note: No scalable cost estimate; permit/declaration are not taxes.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Chinese-company dividend to foreign individual shareholder
eligibility: Actual shareholder entitled to lawful distributable profits after company-level obligations.
steps: Verify company accounts, losses, EIT and statutory reserve allocation under Company Law Art.210.
Obtain a valid distribution resolution and shareholder/beneficial-owner evidence.
Determine PRC withholding and treaty residence/saving-clause treatment; complete required tax filing.
Use the bank’s dividend-remittance checklist and execute after tax/approval.
Report the dividend and any creditable tax on the U.S. return.
pros: Recognized route for genuine company profits.
cons: Not a way to relabel personal savings.
EIT, reserve, withholding and U.S. tax are separate layers.
known_cost_note: Treaty 10% is a conditional ceiling, not an all-in rate. Company profit, reserve and U.S. tax are not collapsed into one number.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Lawful capital reduction / liquidation proceeds
eligibility: Foreign investor with a genuine company undergoing lawful reduction or liquidation.
steps: Follow Company Law creditor notice, balance-sheet, tax and debt-clearance procedures.
Complete liquidation/reduction registrations and tax filings.
Obtain bank/SAFE evidence required for foreign-investor capital remittance.
Remit only the lawful residual proceeds and retain the full corporate trail.
pros: State Council rules recognize lawful liquidation remittance.
cons: Slow, entity-specific and unavailable for ordinary personal savings.
Professional/legal costs are unquoted.
known_cost_note: No personalized liquidation tax or fee amount; do not use a dividend rate for liquidation proceeds.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Genuine cross-border trade/service settlement
eligibility: Actual business with authentic contract, invoice, delivery/service and tax evidence.
steps: Identify the genuine underlying transaction and responsible tax treatment.
Prepare contract/invoice/service evidence and complete any required outbound tax filing.
Submit to the bank for authenticity review; receive payment only as the actual entitled party.
Do not use fake trade or related-party circular payments to move personal savings.
pros: Lawful for real business receipts.
cons: Not a personal-savings conversion method.
VAT/EIT/IIT and bank charges depend on the transaction.
known_cost_note: No universal service fee or tax rate on principal; transaction-specific tax must be calculated separately.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Approved capital-account investment exit / repatriation
eligibility: Only an investor whose original outbound/inbound investment and exit are registered/approved under the applicable program.
steps: Do not assume a personal bank balance qualifies.
Identify the exact investment program and original registration.
Obtain the current SAFE/bank exit checklist and tax clearance requirements.
Execute only after the competent authority/bank confirms the route.
pros: May exist for a genuine approved investment.
cons: No general personal savings permission is established by this research.
Program-specific rules and prices are not verified here.
known_cost_note: All costs blank; this is a research lead, not an executable recommendation.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.

name: Own-account transfer / foreign-gift reporting distinction
eligibility: U.S. person moving own funds or receiving an actual foreign gift/bequest.
steps: Identify whether the recipient owns the funds or receives a true gift/bequest.
Apply FBAR/8938 account reporting to the relevant accounts.
Use Form3520 only when the foreign gift/bequest reporting rules actually apply.
Do not treat a border crossing as creating a gift or a tax-free allowance.
pros: Prevents false gift-tax assumptions.
cons: Does not itself authorize CNY purchase or remittance.
known_cost_note: No conversion price; reporting thresholds are not taxes.
tax_note: No personalized tax amount is calculated. Confirm the underlying income, residence, basis and treaty/credit position before execution.
